metadata.case_name: HUSSAIN KAMRAN v. KHAN, AMAR FORMERLY T/A THREE STAR RECYCLING CO. (A FIRM) AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: packing worker, cleaning worker or security guard

injuries.description: right thumb extensor tendon rupture with repair
source: diagnosis being right thumb extensor tendon rupture with repair done.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of extensor muscle, fascia or tendon of thumb at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: right wrist wound with cut tendon
source: The diagnosis was right wrist wound with cut tendon. Wound exploration and tendon repair was carried out on that day and the plaintiff was discharged on 13th August 2010.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: Partial detachment of the nail of his right thumb
Decrease in right thumb abduction and extension
Residual pain and stiffness on right thumb extension

Intermittent pain over the base of his right thumb and adjacent wrist upon pressure touch, in early morning hours and in cold weather, as well as weakness on the right hand and right thumb numbness or stiffness
Reduction in right thumb movement and reduced right hand grip strength

treatments_received: Wound exploration and tendon repair surgery on 12 August 2010
Physiotherapy (referred 13 August 2010; further referral 27 October 2010; attended 15 sessions from 10 November 2010)
Static extension splint and subsequent splint removal and tendon rehabilitation program

losses.description: Overall functional use of his right hand will be mildly impaired for general purpose and daily activities; mild stiffness and weakness of his right thumb and reduced grip strength

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Restriction to the ability of the plaintiff to play cricket in his spare time
